name: Bekal Camp Fire Dinner
signature_dish: Beach barbecue seafood — grilled catch of the day by a campfire on Bekal beach
why_it_matters: Ranked #1 of restaurants in Bekal on Tripadvisor, Bekal Camp Fire Dinner is a beach-side barbecue experience near Bekal Beach Park run by host Shamsuden — tables set on the sand, the day's catch grilled to order over a campfire. It holds a Kerala Tourism Responsible Tourism Award and is repeatedly cited as safe and welcoming for women travellers.
insider_tip: Book ahead — it is a personalised, host-led beach dinner, not a walk-in restaurant, and seating is limited. Go at sunset for the best of the campfire-and-sea ambience. About a kilometre from Bekal Fort at Pallikere.
signature_address: Bekal Camp Fire Dinner, near Bekal Beach Park, Pallikere, Kasaragod District, Kerala 671316

name: Viceroy Restaurant
area: Kasaragod town — 16km north of Bekal Fort
signature_dish: Kasaragodan biryani — fish, mutton or chicken, a distinct northern-Kerala biryani style
why_it_matters: Ranked #1 of 24 restaurants in Kasaragod on Tripadvisor (4.4/5), Viceroy is the district's reference biryani house — known for a distinct 'Kasaragodan' biryani style and an unusually clean kitchen. It is the standard sit-down meal for visitors basing in Kasaragod town, 16km north of Bekal Fort.
insider_tip: Order the Kasaragodan biryani — locals say it is noticeably different from standard Malabar biryani; mutton is the pick. There is a separate family section. The restaurant is in Kasaragod town, a 16km drive from Bekal Fort.
signature_address: Viceroy Restaurant, Kasaragod town, Kasaragod District, Kerala 671121

name: Indian Coffee House Kasaragod
area: Kasaragod town, near New Bus Stand — 16km north of Bekal
signature_dish: Filter coffee with masala dosa and Kerala meals — worker-cooperative cafe staples
why_it_matters: A branch of the Indian Coffee House worker-cooperative chain near the new bus stand in Kasaragod town. Reviewers single out the Kasaragod branch as unusually clean for the chain, with copious, well-priced Kerala lunch meals — a dependable budget stop in the district headquarters.
insider_tip: Good for an early breakfast (dosa) or a cheap Kerala meals lunch — the lunch thali is well regarded here. Just off the main road near the KSRTC bus stand in Kasaragod town, 16km from Bekal Fort.
signature_address: Indian Coffee House, near New Bus Stand, Kasaragod town, Kasaragod District, Kerala 671121

name: The Nombili, The Lalit Resort Bekal
signature_dish: Authentic Kerala cuisine — appam, stew and seafood curries by the resort pool
why_it_matters: Nombili is the all-day restaurant at The Lalit Resort & Spa Bekal — the area's main upscale dining option, overlooking the resort pool and serving authentic Kerala cuisine alongside North Indian and European dishes. It is the comfortable special-occasion choice in a destination otherwise dominated by resort and town eateries.
insider_tip: Resort dining, priced accordingly — best for a sit-down Kerala meal in air-conditioned comfort. The Lalit also offers private al fresco riverside and lagoon-side dinners; ask about those for a special evening. Non-residents should call ahead.
signature_address: The Nombili, The Lalit Resort & Spa Bekal, Bekal, Kasaragod District, Kerala 671316

name: Udupi Sree Krishna Veg Restaurant
signature_dish: Udupi South Indian vegetarian — masala dosa, idli and meals
why_it_matters: A pure-vegetarian Udupi restaurant on the highway close to Bekal Fort — the practical veg option for visitors in a stretch dominated by seafood and resort dining. It is the dependable stop for cheap, quick South Indian breakfast and meals near the fort.
insider_tip: Convenient before or after a Bekal Fort visit — masala dosa for breakfast, the veg meals at lunch. Basic Udupi-style fare at budget prices; useful when the seafood places are too far or too pricey.
signature_address: Udupi Sree Krishna Veg Restaurant, National Highway, near Bekal Fort, Kasaragod District, Kerala 671316
